v.1: When the earth is rocked with a terrible quake
v.3: and man says, ‘What is the matter with her?’
v.4: On that day she will relate her chronicles
v.5: for her Lord will have inspired her.
v.6: On that day, mankind will issue forth in various groups to be shown their deeds.
v.7: So whoever does an atom’s weight of good will see it,
v.8: and whoever does an atom’s weight of evil will see it.
